name: ElemCopy – Copy To Clipboard for Elementor
author: Pluginable

sections.description:
ElemCopy is a lightweight Elementor widget that allows users to copy any text to their clipboard with a single click. Whether it’s text, email address, links, or custom messages, ElemCopy makes it seamless and user-friendly.

Key Features:
– One-click copy functionality
– Fully customizable button text and style
– Compatible with all modern browsers
– No extra plugins or coding required

Support

For support, visit the Pluginable support page or contact us via our official support channels.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository or from the Pluginable.dev website.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  5. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  6. Once activated, you can start using ElemCopy immediately within Elementor. Simply edit any page with Elementor, search for “ElemCopy” in the widget panel, and drag the widget to your desired section. From there, customize the content and styling to fit your site’s design and functionality needs.
